reason: 该插件的主要面向是局域网协作通信：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 端提供账号制聊天、群组/频道管理、消息已送达与离线补发、以及频道级文件共享，并通过宿主侧持久化消息与离线队列实现可恢复通信。其功能依据仓库说明与结构明确指向即时通信与文件协作用途，而非仅测试/代码生成等单一开发工具型能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件为局域网中的 DeepSeek Harness 用户提供账号制聊天、群组频道和文件共享能力，并支持消息已送达状态、离线补发及桌面未读提醒。
summaries.en: This plugin adds account-based LAN chat, channel-based messaging, and file sharing to DeepSeek Harness with message delivery state, offline resend behavior, and desktop-style unread notifications.

capabilities: LAN peer discovery and discovery fallback transport
Private message ack and offline resend queue

reasons.code: Plugin README describes LAN messaging with mDNS plus UDP broadcast discovery, and temporary TCP/WebSocket channels between nodes.
README lists private-chat ACK and offline resend (outbox) behavior, channel management, and shared file space with upload/download/delete actions.
README notes no end-to-end encryption and plaintext LAN transport, with reliability and trust assumptions restricted to trusted local network environments.
Repository structure includes peer-network, outbox, messaging, file-transfer, shared-file-store, and client/host bridge modules that support these behaviors.
Package manifest declares websocket and mDNS libraries, confirming runtime networking and discovery dependencies.

capabilities: LAN peer discovery and discovery fallback transport
